problem_statement: A transport-complete official DeepSeek Anthropic response can consume max_tokens entirely in reasoning and expose no final Planning artifact. Preserve the normal Planning request exactly and permit only one same-route, same-authority, final-artifact recovery request whose verified provider policy disables reasoning.
in_scope: exact official DeepSeek Anthropic capability binding
out_of_scope: global Anthropic or DeepSeek reasoning defaults
formal manuscript, Canon, StoryState, outline, style, or reference mutation
required_invariants: normal Planning keeps current provider-default reasoning behavior
only exact typed REASONING_ONLY_MAX_TOKENS_NO_FINAL_ARTIFACT can schedule recovery
recovery uses the same logical stage, route, model, frozen authority, schema, and validators
recovery receives a fresh physical identity and at most one external dispatch
only the exact verified official DeepSeek Anthropic route may receive reasoning.effort=none
unverified or unrelated routes fail closed or remain byte-identical
at most one accepted artifact exists per logical stage
no third physical attempt or recovery-family composition beyond the shared ceiling
